# DSH Dev Actions

> A DeepSeek Harness companion plugin that lets the active AI proactively turn repeated development commands, prompts, and habitual instructions into visible, user-triggered sidebar actions.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions
Chinese README: https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions/blob/main/README.md
English README: https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions/blob/main/README.en.md
Contributing: https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
Releases: https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions/releases
Issue tracker: https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions/issues
Workflow ideas and discussion: https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions/discussions/4
License: MIT

## Why use it

AI-assisted development still makes users repeat operational work: finding Flutter device IDs, restarting dev servers, retyping acceptance prompts, running focused tests, and restating collaboration preferences. This plugin makes the model notice reusable patterns and maintain one-click entries beside the conversation. The user does not manually curate the palette.

## Action kinds

- command: runs an exact visible shell command in the DSH Session workspace through the managed Shell and sandbox policy;
- prompt: queues an exact visible user prompt only after an explicit click;
- instruction: inserts exact visible text into the current composer for review and editing.

The model can create, update, deduplicate, list, and retire actions. It cannot execute or send an action merely by creating it.

## Install

Requires DeepSeek Harness Web and Node.js 20+.

    dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar@^0.10.3 https://github.com/skitse/dsh-dev-actions/releases/latest/download/dsh-dev-actions.tgz

Restart `dsh web`, refresh the browser, and open `快捷动作` from Better Sidebar's new-tab menu.

## Model tools

- dev_action_upsert
- dev_action_list
- dev_action_retire
- dev_action_feedback_read
